# Alliance Building & Hazmat Group (Alliance Group) — Full Context Document

## 1. Corporate Identity & Positioning
Alliance Building & Hazmat Group ("Alliance Group") is a Queensland licensed hazardous material contractor and building compliance specialist.
Commercial Shorthand: Alliance Group
Brand Positioning: "Priority Response. Not From Zero."
Core Platform: Compliance Shield™ ($395 + GST document review)
Website: https://www.alliancegroups.com.au
Headquarters: Brisbane, Queensland, Australia
Operating Footprint: South East Queensland including Brisbane, Moreton Bay, Ipswich, Logan, Redlands, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, and Noosa.

## 2. Core Service Offerings & Scope

### A. Asbestos Testing, Removal & Hazmat Compliance
- **NATA-Accredited Testing**: Fast laboratory turnaround (24–48 hours) for residential and commercial building material samples via on-site certified technician extraction and comprehensive whole-home hazard surveys.
- **Licensed Asbestos Removal**: Class A (friable asbestos, thermal insulation, pipe lagging) and Class B (bonded asbestos cement, Super Six roofing, fibro sheeting, vinyl floor underlay) removal under strict containment.
- **Asbestos Registers (s425)**: Mandatory statutory registers for all Queensland commercial, industrial, and common property residential buildings constructed prior to 31 December 1989.
- **Asbestos Management Plans (s429)**: Documented risk control frameworks detailing condition assessments, incident procedures, and 5-year statutory review cycles.
- **Clearance Inspections & Certificates**: Independent visual inspection and atmospheric air monitoring verifying that work areas are thoroughly decontaminated before re-occupancy.

### B. Building Defects & Structural Remediation
- **Diagnostic Defect Investigations**: Forensic analysis of building movement, cracking, spalling concrete ("concrete cancer"), facade failure, and waterproofing failure.
- **Structural Remediation**: Engineered rectification of load-bearing walls, subfloors, concrete slabs, retaining structures, and structural steel framing.
- **Water Ingress Investigation**: Systematic non-destructive testing including thermal imaging, moisture mapping, dye testing, and diagnostic flood testing to identify water entry points.
- **Emergency Building Response**: 24/7 priority deployment for storm damage, structural impact, ceiling collapse, or sudden hazardous material exposure.

### C. Roofing & Diagnostic Leak Rectification
- **Roof Leak Investigation**: Diagnostic tracing of persistent and recurring roof leaks that standard maintenance contractors fail to solve.
- **Commercial & Metal Roof Repairs**: Heavy-gauge corrugated and clip-lock metal roofing repair, custom parapet flashings, valley replacements, and box gutter engineering.
- **Asbestos Super Six Roof Removal**: Specialized licensed removal of aged, brittle corrugated asbestos roofing with immediate replacement with modern insulated Colorbond metal sheeting.
- **Emergency Storm Make-Safe**: Tarping, temporary structural shoring, fallen tree removal from roof structures, and water diversion.

### D. Compliance Shield™ Framework
- An integrated compliance, risk, and response system for property managers, strata body corporates, commercial building owners, and schools.
- Provides a fixed-price $395 + GST compliance audit that checks existing registers, test dockets, and maintenance logs against Queensland statutory standards, delivering a written gap analysis within 48 hours.

## 3. Queensland Statutory & Regulatory Grounding
- *Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (Qld)*
- *Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld)*:
  - Section 425: Requirement to have an Asbestos Register
  - Section 429: Requirement to have an Asbestos Management Plan
  - Section 473: Clearance certificate requirements
- *Code of Practice: How to Manage and Control Asbestos in the Workplace 2021*
- *Code of Practice: How to Safely Remove Asbestos 2021*
- *Queensland Building and Construction Commission Act 1991*
- *National Construction Code (NCC) 2022*
